stem: Woody plant responses to herbivory were always thought to be ____; however, some scientists have reported localized responses to herbivory in certain woody plants.

Confidence in the nation's finances, barely nailed together by international financial institutions a few weeks ago, is still such a (i)____ structure that the slightest disturbance could set it (ii)____.

The antiestablishment comedy of the early 1960s developed in reaction to an age that was more (i)____, a time when standing on a stage to make fun of a political leader or government official was a (ii)____ act. In those days, the laughter of the audience was something for politicians to be afraid of, because it signaled a (iii)____ in the public attitude toward the whole political class. Today, every politician is a target of satire and comedy, and laughter has become a reflexive, tired reaction to situations too depressing to evaluate clearly.
The ear is much more ____ than the eye: only the ear can tell a source that oscillates 30 times a second from one that oscillates 60 times a second.

Cash crops require committed, systematic cultivation; rubber tapping, on the other hand, is much more of ____ enterprise: it is largely a matter of stumbling upon a rubber plant that is ready for harvesting.

Like its protagonists, who are caught up in a historical moment that ____ the possibility of self-fulfillment, the novel Ready to Burst by Haitian writer Franketienne moves in disorienting circles, never progressing or achieving closure.
There are many contemporary composers who receive coveted commissions, only to see their creations ____ after one performance.
